title: Solana DvP Pre-Funding Terms Verifier
description: Values-only recompute of the Solana Foundation DvP pre-funding checklist over a pasted SwapDvp record, mint descriptors and the funder-supplied agreed terms. The README requires funders to verify, before depositing, that the record is owned by the pinned DvP program id, is exactly SwapDvp::LEN (458) bytes, and carries the agreed terms (amount_a/amount_b, expiry, earliest, user_a/user_b, settlement_authority, both settlement destinations) because CreateDvp is permissionless and a forged create with attacker destinations would redirect settlement proceeds. The verifier also applies the program windows (earliest <= expiry, expiry <= creation + one year as a fixed 365-day year, expiry in the future at a required caller-supplied cluster timestamp - never the system clock), the Token-2022 blocked-extension deny list (TransferFeeConfig, InterestBearingConfig, ScaledUiAmountConfig, NonTransferable) and the 32-per-leg transfer-hook extras cap, and surfaces the trusted-authority risks the program accepts as-is (PermanentDelegate, Pausable, MintCloseAuthority, mutable TransferHook, ConfidentialTransfer, DefaultAccountState/freeze authority) as trust flags. Values only: no RPC, no PDA derivation, no keys. The output is a recompute, not legal finality and not proof of agreement; the Cantina audit scope mapping for this program commit is UNVERIFIED and never cited as coverage.

owner_program_id.description: The pasted account owner program id. Must equal the pinned DvP program id dvp34bdbcEm4f4FCUjGV4mDAkDshaQR4LkK8fdcsyZq.

byte_length.description: The pasted account data length in bytes. Must be exactly 458 (SwapDvp::LEN struct pin).

now.description: REQUIRED cluster unix timestamp in seconds (Clock::unix_timestamp). Cluster time, not wall-clock; the system clock is never read.

creation_timestamp.description: The record's creation cluster time (i64 decimal string); the one-year expiry cap is measured from it.

nonce.description: The pasted nonce value as a non-empty string (the README advises a cryptographically random 64-bit nonce per trade).

mint_a.description: Leg A mint address as pasted.

mint_b.description: Leg B mint address as pasted.

token_program_a.description: Leg A token program as pasted (struct pin: owner of mint_a captured at Create).

token_program_b.description: Leg B token program as pasted (struct pin: owner of mint_b captured at Create).

destination_a.description: user A's settlement destination (receives the cash leg mint_b proceeds) as pasted.

destination_b.description: user B's settlement destination (receives the asset leg mint_a proceeds) as pasted.

mint_a_authority.description: mint_a's mint authority captured at Create as pasted (struct pin).

mint_b_authority.description: mint_b's mint authority captured at Create as pasted (struct pin).

amount_a.description: Leg A amount as pasted, decimal string in u64 range.

amount_b.description: Leg B amount as pasted, decimal string in u64 range.

expiry_timestamp.description: The record's expiry_timestamp (i64 decimal string). Only Settle rejects after it (README Notes line 24).

earliest_settlement_timestamp.description: The record's earliest_settlement_timestamp, or null for None (no lower bound; struct pin lines 40-44).

mint_a_extensions.description: Token-2022 extension names present on mint_a (caller-read off-chain). Unknown names are refused.

mint_b_extensions.description: Token-2022 extension names present on mint_b (caller-read off-chain). Unknown names are refused.

mint_a_frozen_by_default.description: mint_a carries DefaultAccountState frozen (or starts accounts frozen).

mint_b_frozen_by_default.description: mint_b carries DefaultAccountState frozen (or starts accounts frozen).

leg_a_extras_count.description: Hook trailing accounts resolved for leg A (u8 0-255); must be <= 32 per leg (MAX_HOOK_REMAINING_ACCOUNTS).

leg_b_extras_count.description: Hook trailing accounts resolved for leg B (u8 0-255); must be <= 32 per leg.

expected.description: The funder-supplied agreed deal the record is verified against. Supplying the forged record's own values here makes the check circular.

amount_a.description: Agreed leg A amount, decimal string.

amount_b.description: Agreed leg B amount, decimal string.

earliest_settlement_timestamp.description: Agreed earliest, i64 decimal string or null for no lower bound.

input_schema_provenance: Top-level properties are exactly the policy_parameters members the kernel reads: owner_program_id, byte_length, now, creation_timestamp, nonce, the eleven address fields, amount_a/amount_b, expiry_timestamp, earliest_settlement_timestamp, the per-mint extension/freeze descriptors, leg_a/b_extras_count and expected.
author: PostOakLabs

warnings: Values-only recompute over pasted data: NOT legal finality and NOT proof of agreement. CreateDvp is permissionless — a record is not proof of agreement (README Notes: the economic terms are not part of the PDA seeds).
The Cantina audit scope mapping for this program commit is UNVERIFIED (the report lists a different repository); this output never cites the audit as coverage.
The one-year expiry cap is recomputed against a fixed 365-day year (31,536,000 seconds) from the creation timestamp you supply.
Cluster time lag: the cluster clock is a validator-vote median that lags real time ~10-30s and can jump; budget ~60s of drift around expiry and earliest boundaries.
output_example.expected_terms_note: Verification is only as good as the expected terms supplied: they come from the funder's record of the agreed deal, and supplying the forged record's own values as "expected" makes the check circular.
